reviews.text: Excellent grooming. Quite expensive but worth the price.

Wonderful experience w/ my pup! She’s an entirely new and calm little baby thanks to the kind people at Zen Animals! They were able to manage her anxiety flawlessly, and I am definitely sticking by this groomer!

Incredible experience! I came in for a last-minute, same-day appointment with my puppy for her very first grooming, and the ladies at Zen Animals took such amazing care of us. They were so sweet and gentle with my baby, made us both feel completely comfortable, and I could tell right away she was in great hands.

They gave her back to me looking brand new, happy, clean, and absolutely adorable. It’s clear these are genuinely good people who love animals, take pride in what they do, and are super professional from start to finish.

Don’t hesitate to book with them. I’m so grateful for how well they treated my girl and can’t wait to bring her back!
Always does a beautiful job with our Bella and they're affordable! 10/10 would recommend.
Amazing work and was very quick with my Moochi. This is her 2nd grooming experience and I love it. Will definitely be back!

We cannot express enough gratitude to the team at Zen Animals Clean and Holistic! If you have a dog that gets terrified at the groomer, bring them here! We have a 2 - year-old Mini Bernedoodle who has historically been extremely anxious during grooming. Every previous place we took him to gave up and called us almost immediately to pick him up because he was too frightened, jumped around, and refused to stay still. Because of this, his hair went untrimmed, and after we tried (and failed) to cut it with scissors at home, he became severely matted. He desperately needed a professional cut, and we were running out of options.
We decided to take a chance on Zen Animals after finding them online. From the moment we called, they treated us with so much respect. They matched us with a groomer with over 20 years of experience who came out to meet our dog and gave us genuine hope. While our pup wasn't cooperative at first, the groomer’s incredible patience and expertise won him over, allowing him to complete the full haircut.
At that point, the cost didn't matter—they rightfully earned every single penny for their hard work. We learned that anxious dogs truly need the right people with the right experience and touch. When our family went to pick him up, we were completely blown away and thrilled with the final result.

They treated our whole family wonderfully and have officially earned our business for life. We are beyond grateful for how deeply they cared for our family dog. Highly recommend Zen Animals to anyone, especially those with anxious or fearful pups!
Great job taking of Nike!
Great experience !
They always do an amazing job with grooming my pup. You can tell they genuinely love animals!
Great service & fast
Always quality service!
My experience with zen animals is always a great one. I’ve been coming here for over 15 yrs
Coco loves it here so happy we found a grooming location close to home
I love them! Have been hsing them every since i got my Yorkie! Amazing!
Esteban great service the best

This place has really gone downhill. I’ve been bringing my dog here since the day I got him, and somehow they’ve managed to give him the wrong haircut twice.

The first time, they shaved him down. Mistakes happen, so I let it go. I specifically made another appointment and made sure his usual cut was noted in his chart, only for them to do the exact same thing again. Instead of taking accountability or apologizing, the excuse was, “The person who dropped him off didn’t say anything.”

How is that acceptable when his grooming instructions are already in his file and he gets the same haircut every single time?

The lack of accountability is frustrating. On top of that, the prices seem to change constantly. As a long-time customer, I expected much better service. If I could give zero stars, I would.
Very professional!
I have been going to Zen Animals for years. Highly recommend taking your sweet pets for grooming. Always provide top-of-the-line service & treat my puppy with love
I took my dog Penny to Zen Animals Clean and Holistic Pet Spa and had such a great experience. Her haircut came out so cute and the whole vibe was calm and professional. I would recommend.
I always have a good experience here at Zen Animals! My dogs always come back smelling so good and looking lovely!

Love love love!! The staff is amazing and they’re so attentive to detail. Everytime I bring my dog in, they’re so receptive of what I want for him. I’ve been going here for months and will continue to do so!
Best grooming job I’ve ever had! Also they were super friendly, helpful, and quick to get an appointment with. Will be back!

Avoid this place. I had an appointment set up for 130pm and they didn't get to grooming my dog til 4 hours later. Never received a notice or call I showed up to see if my dog was done. Otherwise i would not have known that they were delayed. The woman at the desk had no sense of urgency or care that this delay was an inconvenience. I've had other issues with them in the past but this lack of communication and professionalism takes the cake.
This is Buttercups home groomers. They always do such a good job with her and take care of all of our grooming needs. The staff is always pleasant and easy to work with.
I love Zen Animals And Izzy loves them too
I’ve been coming to Zen for years! They’re always so sweet and gentle with Kendrick. Def recommend!
I’ve been going to this groomer for many years and they never disappoint! My Milo always smells fresh, and they take their time. Thanks so much for your service!
My baby always looks so beautiful after a visit! She’s done her baths, daycare and overnight visits here when we’re out of town! I love this place!
My pup always gets the best cuts here. So happy to have Zen in the neighborhood :)
Great Service
Zen Animals is great - I’ve done boarding and grooming often.

Hi, not happy with the service, I brought my cat for grooming, I was there on time, I end up being there for about two 2 hour, 1:45 to after 3:00, for them to tell me that they can't do it. WHY? "because his to matted and they have to take mattes out first before washing." What cat is going let you do that first. I'm thinking this a professional place and they have stuff to soak/soften is mattes.

I thank they only cater to dogs and not cats, but that's ok I love dogs too and that's why I give 2 stars. BUT!! Let the customers know if your cat matted problem is difficult, you can't do the grooming. Don't have customers waiting with no answers another what going with their pet.

Why, my cat is so matted, he has a jaw problem, so it hard for him to clean himself. SO, I have figure something out myself.

Yes, they left him in his crate all that time, no water, at the front desk. I was there waiting all the time and dont know what was going on, so in the last 30min they come tell what's going on and to try work on him.

JUST!!! Tell me he needs to go to a veterinary to to get service, because  he my get stress or agitated.

I really wanted to like this place due to them being able to take dogs with short notice, but each time I have been a little dissatisfied. The second time it took my dog in just for a bath it took the over 7 hours. I don’t think they even took my dog out to relieve himself because he seemed desperate to have to go to the bathroom after. I decided to give them one more try for a full groom. I showed pictures of how I wanted my dog cut. When I went to pick him up his face still was not fully trimmed. They also put a fragrance on him that was awful, and I had to give him another bath when I got home to get the smell off. I think this place has potential, but clearly need to work out some kinks.
Super sweet people. But the place is dirty. It smells like urine. The dog washing area in the back (which most customers do not see closely) is filthy.

I had a very concerning experience at this grooming salon.

During Bella’s appointment, she was injured while being groomed. Bella is a 5lb toy poodle. Although I was informed there was an issue at pickup, the severity was not clearly communicated. When I got home, she was bleeding significantly and I had to take her to the emergency vet, where she required treatment, bandaging, and a cone.

I followed up multiple times, including speaking directly with the manager, and requested a reasonable resolution. Despite this, they declined responsibility and instead attributed the injury to pre-existing conditions, which does not align with my dog’s recent veterinary care.

What was most upsetting was the lack of transparency around the severity of the injury and the unwillingness to take accountability after the fact.

I would strongly encourage others to ask detailed questions about how incidents are handled and communicated.

Updates: Do not bring your small dog here, they are not trained to deal with the little ones! Some of these reviews on here are misleading, ppl giving them 5/5 stars although they had a less than ideal experience. I am not one to post a negative business review, but my poor baby is badly hurt and the fact that all they could offer after I had incur an unexpected $600+ expense in one day because of their bad service is 50% off the next appointment is absolutely absurd. Why would I want to bring her back here?
They have updated their terms conditions so I’m updating my review…. I’m glad they corrected it . We will be back 😌 …

Poor unprofessional, grooming service for anxious dogs ! Every time my I picked my dog up she had scratches and bruises they did not tell me about. Make sure to check your dog thoroughly after pickup !!  I’ve taken my dog to another groomer far away twice where she has NEVER came back with any injuries. In the photo my dog’s paw got seriously nicked and you can see the tiny drops of dried up blood. Please hire more patient groomers.

I don’t recommend this groomer if you care about the safety and wellbeing of your pet. I had taken my two dogs here a few times and was generally okay with the quality of the grooming, but once one of my dogs become extremely reluctant to enter the door I became suspicious. After this final grooming, I found an infected nail that had been trimmed way too short. After contacting Zen Animals, they took no accountability.

Besides the safety and wellbeing concerns, I’ve never been completely satisfied with the grooming outcomes. They never fully execute what I ask for and always seem extremely judgmental when I ask for a specific hairstyle.

If I could give this place a zero I would.

My dog came in this past Saturday to be groomed. Once he was picked up and taken outside my partner noticed visible cuts on him. He went back inside and addressed the receptionist.

She stated that his fur was matted (it wasn’t) and he got nicked. That should have been addressed immediately upon arrival but it was not.

Once he got home I then noticed he had more cuts. One his body, hind leg and his private area. I believe there is more but he won’t allow me to touch him much. My dog can barely walk, isn’t eating and is laying still.

My partner called and was told through text btw that he had a skin irritation and that what we were seeing was from the skin irritation solely.

The stories has changed dramatically the owner s unwilling to take calls and they like to respond to issues through text. No one is taking responsibility for the butchered job that was done to my dog and I am HIGHLY upset and disappointed.

EDITED: I really wish I could respond directly to your response but I can’t so I will add my comment here.

You’re stating that my dog had a skin allergy but that was not shared at time or pick up. Nor was that ever something that was brought up during any other grooming services or even by your team when he came in the past. With that being said what does a skin allergy have to do with visible cuts and nicks? My dog was unable to walk properly for weeks after his visit. We had to literally pick him up to take him outside. He hid nicks near his privates, close to his tail, under his tail, his hind leg, and upper body. My dog was literally CRYING.

I had to demand to speak to the owner because she did not want to deal with the situation. You have piss poor customer service. When your wrongs were addressed you refused to take accountability for your mistakes. Instead stating that you have professionals that have been grooming for years. Now that might be true however they are humans and all humans are subject to error. Again when I spoke to the owner,  which I am sure it is you. I pointed out many inconsistencies with the time stamps and photos. I still have all of our communications in my phone and I could easily share them to show how totally unwilling you were to accept any accountability or to even offer a mere “Sorry” for the botched grooming service my dog received. Instead you chose to give a word salad of excuses and that is totally unacceptable. I wish I had taken videos as well and more photos because what I have isn’t enough and people who are potential customers need to see how careless you are with caring for animals before they decide to do business with you.
